method: Stratified targeted enumeration over (delivery_status, dismissal) routes and a running/boundary/penalty grid; every fact set is solved with the frozen solver and deduplicated by the 12-field record. No random sampling.
notes: reachable_canonical reproduces the t4 contract probe grid and is compared against the published per-layer `reachable_cap`; reachable_extended adds headroom.
Selection prefers canonical records in ascending record-sha256 order, then extended headroom, exactly as the contract's assignment rule requires.
